Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Operating System: The laptop shall be supplied with preloaded genuine Windows 11 Prof essional. RAM: The laptop shall have a minimum of 16 GB DDR5 RAM with a speed of 5600 MT/s o r higher, in single-channel or dual-channel configuration. 3. Storage (SSD):The laptop shall be supplied with a minimum 1 TB NVMe PCIe Gen4 SSD o r higher. 4. Wireless Connectivity:The laptop shall support Wi-Fi 6E, 2×2 configuration, and Bluetoot h 5.3 or higher. 5. OEM Support:The OEM shall provide an online hardware diagnostics facility and a websit e for downloading software, device drivers, BIOS and firmware updates. 6. Warranty Verification:Product specifications and warranty details shall be verifiable throu gh the laptop serial number on the OEM's official website. 7. Local Content Declaration: The applicable Local Content Declaration shall be submitted i n accordance with the prevailing Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) policy.(t he price ceiling for a laptop is ₹1,00,000/- plus applicable taxes, which is enhanced to ₹1,30,000/- plus applicable taxes for devices having a Make-in-India (MII) component of mo re than 40%, subject to the prescribed conditions.) 8. Malicious Code Declaration: The OEM shall submit a declaration regarding malicious code on its letterhead, in accordance with the requirements of the bid. 9. Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF):*The bidder shall submit a Manufacturer Authoriz ation Form issued by the OEM on its letterhead, mentioning the relevant GeM Bid Number, bidder's name, address and phone number, and authorizing the bidder to participate in the bid and supply the offered products. 10. OEM Eligibility Documents:The bidder shall submit the applicable OEM eligibility docum ents, technical datasheets, declarations and supporting documents required under the bid. All documents shall be valid and verifiable. General Condition: All bidders shall be evaluated uniformly in accordance with the publishe d GeM Bid conditions, applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions, and prevailing Gover nment procurement rules. .
